heading: Promotions; pay and allowances
lead: An officer who is promoted under section 2121 of this title shall be entitled to the pay and allowances of the grade to which promoted from his date of rank in such grade.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282, § 123(b)(2), substituted “section 2121” for “section 271”. Pub. L. 115–282, § 112(b), renumbered section 274 of this title as this section.
